value.rationale: A structural optimal-transport extremal comparison for every cone over an arbitrary finite graph is materially broader than a special-family norm calculation. It gives a best-possible time-dependent bound and an exact equality criterion, then a sharp transient peak and asymptotic diameter saturation. This applies without graph regularity, connectedness, or symmetry assumptions on the periphery; it identifies a useful robust control mechanism for graph diffusion.
